editor.solubility.ambiguousText: Another board matches every one of these clues, so no amount of reasoning can tell players which one you drew. They could fill a board that fits all the clues and still not be marked solved. Change a few cells; this warning clears once your board is the only answer.
editor.solubility.guessingText: Your board is the only answer, but players can't reach it one line at a time. At some point they have to guess a cell and follow it until something contradicts, which is much harder than the built-in puzzles. Changing a few cells usually fixes it.
editor.solubility.unknownText: This board took too long to check. It may have more than one answer, or need guessing.
editor.solubility.note: Every generated puzzle can be solved line by line: each step follows from one strip's clue and the cells already known.

tutorial.0.body: Numbers outside the triangle describe touching filled cells. Read each clue from outside toward the board. A 0 means leave that strip empty. Tap to fill, tap again to cross, and again to clear. When every clue fits, press Submit; a wrong answer clears the board.
tutorial.0.title: 1 / 3 · Four cells
tutorial.1.body: Multiple numbers describe separate 'runs' of filled cells with at least one empty cell between them. Swipe or scroll to see the third set of clues.
tutorial.1.title: 2 / 3 · Nine cells
tutorial.2.body: A strip is a row of cells. Every cell belongs to three strips. Turn to inspect all three sets of clues. Your active solving time and completed turns are recorded; share your result when you finish.
tutorial.2.title: 3 / 3 · Sixteen cells
ui.autoCrossHelp: Crosses the remaining cells of any line whose clue is met. Clues are matched by pattern only, so a run filled in the wrong place spreads its mistake.
ui.hidden-utilities-toggle-press-three-t: Hidden utilities toggle: press three times
intro.0.title: How to Play
intro.0.body: Delta Triplex is a logic puzzle based on the {nonogram}. The object of the game is to fill in the correct number of cells in each row of the triangle.
intro.1.title: Fill in what you know
intro.1.body: Each row's hint lists its runs of touching filled cells, in order. Separate numbers mean separate runs, with at least one empty cell between them. Tap any hint to highlight its row.
intro.2.title: Solve one row at a time
intro.2.body: Work one row at a time. Fill cells that every possible arrangement of its hint covers, and cross cells that none of them use. Each new mark narrows the rows that cross it. Tap the triangle to go one step at a time.
intro.diagram: A five-row triangle demonstrating filled cells, diagonal row clues, and empty cells marked with crosses.
intro.row: Row {row}, going {direction}: the circled hint describes the highlighted cells.
intro.blank: Start with an empty triangle. What do the longest rows tell us?
intro.fill: The hint is {count}, and this row has exactly {count} cells. Fill them all.
intro.cross: The {count} filled cells already satisfy this hint. Cross out the remaining cells in this row.
intro.empty: A hint of 0 means this row has no filled cells. Cross it out.
intro.exact: The runs {runs}, with one empty cell between each, take up exactly {count} cells. They fit only one way.
intro.overlap: However the runs {runs} slide along these {count} cells, some cells are covered every time. Fill those.
intro.fit: With the marks already in this row, the runs {runs} fit only one way. Complete it.
intro.narrow: The marks already in this row limit where the runs {runs} can go. Every remaining arrangement agrees on the new marks.
intro.turn: No visible hint tells us more. Turn the triangle to use the third set of hints.
intro.3.title: Turn for a new perspective
intro.3.body: Only two of three sides’ hints are visible at any given time. Swipe or scroll the triangle to turn it and reveal the third.
intro.rotation: The triangle has three directions of rows. Turning reveals another set of hints.

online.title: Online features
online.notice: Daily puzzles and solve rankings come from deltatriplex.com, the game's own server. When you solve a daily or Endless puzzle, your time, rotations and a random player code are sent there. There are no accounts, ads or third-party trackers.
online.noticeOff: Turn this off to keep everything on this device. Endless, Create and How to Play work offline; daily puzzles and rankings don't. You can change this any time in Settings.
